name: polls
author: Takaro
description: In-game polls. Admins start a timed poll with numbered options, players vote with pollvote <n> (one vote each, changeable until the poll closes), anyone can check live results with poll. When the poll ends or an admin closes it early, the results are broadcast, optionally posted to Discord, and voters can get a small currency reward.

maxOptions.title: Max options
maxOptions.description: Most answer options one poll may have.

maxDurationMinutes.title: Max duration (minutes)
maxDurationMinutes.description: Longest a poll may run. Polls close on the next minute after their end time.

voteReward.title: Vote reward
voteReward.description: Currency each voter gets when the poll closes. 0 = no reward. Needs the economy to be enabled.

announceVotes.title: Announce votes
announceVotes.description: Broadcast a short 'X voted' line (without the choice) every time someone votes for the first time.

postResultsToDiscord.title: Post results to Discord
postResultsToDiscord.description: Also post the final results to a Discord channel. Needs Discord connected to Takaro and a channel ID below.

discordChannelId.title: Discord channel ID
discordChannelId.description: Discord channel ID for the results post. Only used when 'Post results to Discord' is on.

poll.description: Show the live poll results. Admins: poll create <minutes> <question> | <option1> | <option2> ... and poll close.
poll.helpText: poll = live results. poll create <minutes> <question> | <option1> | <option2> | ... (POLLS_MANAGE). poll close = end the poll now (POLLS_MANAGE).

pollvote.description: Vote for an option of the running poll. You can change your vote until the poll closes.
pollvote.helpText: pollvote <number> - vote for option <number> of the running poll.

arguments.name: option
arguments.helpText: The option number to vote for.

poll-tick.description: Closes the running poll once its time is up.
